_comment: P0 테이블 스코프 감사기 회귀 데이터. 게이트웨이 JS 이식판이 이 케이스를 전부 통과해야 한다. allowlist 예시 = {gold_transit_dong_now} (한 제품). expect=pass 는 감사 통과(안전), expect=block 은 차단(위험).

cases.name: clean_direct
cases.sql: SELECT gu FROM gold_transit_dong_now WHERE gu = :gu

cases.name: clean_cte
cases.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT gu FROM gold_transit_dong_now) SELECT * FROM s

cases.name: clean_limit_n
cases.sql: SELECT gu FROM gold_transit_dong_now ORDER BY 1 LIMIT :n

cases.name: param_named_from
cases.sql: SELECT gu FROM gold_transit_dong_now WHERE ymd BETWEEN :from AND :to

cases.name: json_each_array_in
cases.sql: SELECT gu FROM gold_transit_dong_now WHERE gu IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(:gus))

cases.name: comma_join_keys
cases.sql: SELECT k.key_hash, k.email FROM gold_transit_dong_now c, _keys k

cases.name: comma_join_usage
cases.sql: SELECT u.count FROM gold_transit_dong_now c, _usage u LIMIT :n

cases.name: comma_join_pragma_tvf
cases.sql: SELECT t.name FROM gold_transit_dong_now c, pragma_table_info('_keys') t

cases.name: scalar_subquery_comma
cases.sql: SELECT c.gu, (SELECT k.email FROM gold_transit_dong_now x, _keys k LIMIT 1) AS leak FROM gold_transit_dong_now c

cases.name: schema_qualified_keys
cases.sql: SELECT email FROM gold_transit_dong_now c, main._keys
